The '''Brentaal system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was home to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]] and six other worlds.<ref name="CatCW" /> It was located in the [[Bormea sector/Legends|Bormea sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The [[Star/Legends|star]] of the system was [[Brenta]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the space above [[Javaal]] was the theater of a [[Battle of Javaal|battle]] concluded with a Republic victory.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=space|Javaal Fleet Action}}</ref>
